tickets.title: libshort: base62 encode
tickets.context: Implement short_encode in libshort/src/encode.c as documented in libshort/include/short.h: write n in base62 using SHORT_ALPHABET, most significant digit first, no padding (0 encodes as "0"), NUL-terminate, return the length. C11 with -Wall -Werror; include "short.h" and only standard headers.

tickets.title: libshort: base62 decode
tickets.context: Implement short_decode in libshort/src/decode.c as documented in libshort/include/short.h: parse a base62 code (digit values follow SHORT_ALPHABET: 0-9, then a-z = 10..35, then A-Z = 36..61). Return -1 without touching *out for NULL, empty, a character outside the alphabet, or a value that overflows uint64_t (check before multiplying); else store the value and return 0. C11 with -Wall -Werror; include "short.h" and only standard headers.

tickets.title: libshort: FNV-1a hash
tickets.context: Implement short_hash in libshort/src/hash.c: 32-bit FNV-1a over the bytes of the NUL-terminated string (offset basis 2166136261, prime 16777619, xor then multiply, all in uint32_t). C11 with -Wall -Werror; include "short.h" and only standard headers.

tickets.title: libshort: string hash table
tickets.context: Implement the short_table API in libshort/src/table.c as documented in libshort/include/short.h: a string->string hash table with separate chaining, bucket = short_hash(key) % buckets (0 buckets means 1). Copy keys and values in with malloc+memcpy (strdup is not available under -std=c11). table_set overwrites an existing key (freeing the old value) and returns -1 on NULL arguments. Define struct short_table yourself (replace the stub struct). C11 with -Wall -Werror; include "short.h" and only standard headers.

tickets.title: libshort: shortener
tickets.context: Implement the shortener API in libshort/src/shortener.c as documented in libshort/include/short.h, on top of short_table and short_encode: ids start at 1; the code for an id is short_encode(id); keep two tables (code -> url and url -> code) so adding a known url returns its existing code. Returned strings must be the pointers stored in the tables. Define struct shortener yourself (replace the stub struct). C11 with -Wall -Werror; include "short.h" and only standard headers.

tickets.title: api: in-memory store
tickets.context: Implement the Store class in api/mugge_api/store.py exactly as specified in api/API.md: ids from 1, the same url returns its existing id, hit counters, KeyError for unknown ids in hit/hits. Pure Python, standard library only.
acceptance: python3 -m unittest discover -t api -s api/tests -p test_store.py

tickets.title: api: ctypes binding to libshort
tickets.context: Implement encode and decode in api/mugge_api/binding.py with ctypes over libshort/build/libshort.so (declared in libshort/include/short.h), exactly as specified in api/API.md. Keep LIB_PATH as it is. Load the library lazily on first call and cache it; set argtypes/restype (c_uint64, c_char_p, c_size_t, POINTER(c_uint64), c_int). Encode into a ctypes.create_string_buffer of 12 bytes. Raise ValueError for out-of-range or non-int input to encode (bool and float are not ints here) and for non-str or invalid codes in decode.
acceptance: make -C libshort lib && python3 -m unittest discover -t api -s api/tests -p test_binding.py

tickets.title: api: request handlers
tickets.context: Implement App.handle in api/mugge_api/handlers.py exactly as specified in api/API.md: route GET /health, POST /shorten, GET /lookup/<code>, GET /stats, returning (status, dict). Use self.store, self.codec.encode/decode and is_valid_url; ignore any query string; 405 for a known path with the wrong method, 404 otherwise. Keep the constructor as it is.

tickets.title: api: HTTP server
tickets.context: Implement make_server, start and main in api/mugge_api/server.py exactly as specified in api/API.md, with http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer and a BaseHTTPRequestHandler subclass that forwards GET and POST to app.handle(self.command, self.path, body) and writes the dict back as JSON with Content-Type application/json and Content-Length. Override log_message to stay quiet. start() runs serve_forever in a daemon thread.
acceptance: make -C libshort lib && python3 -m unittest discover -t api -s api/tests -p test_server.py
